_about: API endpoints and limits used by submit.py. Verified 2026-11-02. If a call starts failing (404/410/changed body), re-read the doc URL, then override in .get-found/endpoints.override.json.

indexnow.key_rules: 8-128 chars of a-z A-Z 0-9 and '-'; served as UTF-8 text at /{key}.txt (or keyLocation on the same host)

responses.200: OK — received (not a promise of indexing)
responses.403: Forbidden — key not valid / key file not found
responses.422: Unprocessable — URLs don't belong to the host or key doesn't match
responses.429: Too many requests — slow down (possible spam signal)

google.indexing_api_allowed_for: JobPosting and BroadcastEvent (in VideoObject) pages; news/UGC/real-time content only via Google's application program (Oct 2026). Never for regular pages otherwise.
google.sitemap_ping: retired 2023 (returns 404) — submit via API/Search Console/robots.txt instead

bing.auth: API key (?apikey=) from Bing Webmaster Tools > Settings > API Access, or OAuth 2.0 (webmaster.read / webmaster.manage)
bing.note: SOAP/POX endpoints retired 2026-08-31; JSON only. Microsoft recommends IndexNow as the primary real-time submission method; URL Submission API remains for quota-based submission.
